verdict.rationale: Retell documents its own production-monitoring features. The Analytics dashboard tracks success rate, latency, cost and concurrency. AI QA scores sampled calls for hallucination, latency and tool usage to surface quality issues. Real-time call_started, call_ended and call_analyzed webhooks report call activity as it happens. However, nothing documents threshold-based alerting when agents misbehave or error rates spike; users would have to build that themselves on top of the webhooks. Missing for 10: native alerting/notification rules on error-rate or QA-score thresholds, an explicit live in-progress call monitoring view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can monitor live calls in production and get alerts when agents misbehave or error rates spike

citations.quote: Build custom Retell analytics dashboards to track call and chat metrics like success rate, latency, cost, and concurrency, with charts, filters, and breakdowns.
AI QA scores Retell calls on hallucination, knowledge base accuracy, latency, sentiment, and tool usage to surface quality trends and issues.
call_started, call_ended, and call_analyzed events delivered to your server so you can react to call activity without polling.
Webhooks allow your application to receive real-time notifications about events that occur in your Retell AI account.
